text:
alex: Quick design check — I'm iterating on the console 'mini-map' sidebar regrouping. Proposal: collapse 'Models' + 'Datasets' into a single top-level 'Assets' group and surface breadcrumbs when you drill in. Sketch: https://staging.redwood/design/mini-map-v3.png

mei: I like simplifying, but worried about discoverability for new users. If we collapse, can we add a short contextual tooltip and a deep-linkable tour? e.g., `/console/w/:org/assets?tour=models`

sam: Implementation note — we'll need route aliases/redirects to preserve old permalinks. Example redirect rules we can add to the router:```js
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/assets/models/:id', status: 301 }
{ from: '/datasets/:id', to: '/assets/datasets/:id', status: 301 }
```Also we should support legacy shortlinks like `/m/:id` -> `/assets/models/:id` for a transition period.

rachel: Accessibility nits: collapsed groups must expose `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. When the group state changes, announce it via live region so screen reader users know the context switched. Also keyboard nav: the group header should be tabbable and toggle with space/enter.

alex: Good point. Copy-wise I'm unsure about the label 'Assets' — feels generic. Alternatives: 'Model assets', 'Data & Models', or keep 'Models & Datasets' as-is but allow a compact display name. Thoughts?

mei: My vote: 'Assets' with an explicit tooltip that reads "Models & Datasets". Keeps leftrail tidy for power users and still readable for newcomers. Breadcrumb pattern should be: `Workspace > Assets > Models > {model-name}` and deep links must allow `?view=split` or `?panel=metrics`.

sam: Routing example for deep links: `/console/w/acme/assets/models/123?view=split&panel=metrics`. We need to persist scroll anchor and split view state across route updates — might require keeping split view state in the querystring rather than internal-only state. Caching note: combining continuous-batching UI updates with route changes caused some jank in the preview.

jon-bot: deploy-preview: https://staging-console.redwood/preview/mini-map-v3 (build 4821) :eyes:

rachel: From research: users expect 'Models' as a top-level item. Recommended transition: show a lightweight banner for 2 weeks "Models moved to Assets — take a tour" with a CTA. Measure clicks on the CTA and the fallback use of search. Also A/B test label variations (Assets vs Data & Models).

alex: Agreed. Action items: 
- @sam: implement route aliases + 301 redirects and ensure scroll anchor preserved.
- @mei: update IA sketches, add tooltip microcopy and generate new icon treatments.
- @rachel: draft banner copy and short research script for the A/B.

Target: alpha roll to staging next Thursday. If anyone has blockers speak up now. :thumbsup:

mei: Minor copy suggestion for the banner: "Models are now under Assets — view the new layout or take a guided tour." Short CTA: "Show me" / "Take tour"

sam: No blockers from infra side, will add route aliases and a temporary redirect middleware. I'll post a PR link when ready.

rachel: I'll add the screen reader acceptance criteria to the ticket: live region announcement + keyboard-only nav + focus management when moving into the group.

alex: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap item and pin the sketch in the thread.
